descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S08 Field present or absent × context → value as on the photo, or blank (never invented)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 A scan never invents an MRN, room or name. A field the photo did not have is left blank and flagged. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 6; TFA-92580 How it works 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Lists whose cells or columns are missing on purpose

When Each is read by scanCensusSheet

Then MRN column absent → mrn blank on every row. Room/unit cell empty → blank. Diagnosis empty → blank. DOB absent → blank. Age empty → blank. No admit-date column → admit_date blank. No hospital-day column → day_num blank. Every field that is present comes back exactly as on the photo, in both contexts

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Decision table, cell by cell, against the truth JSON. Compare the raw scanCensusSheet rows after cleanScannedName/isLikelyPatientRow (Hospital) or extractedResidents (Nursing Home), never after buildScannedPatient/submitScan, which turn blanks into '—', dayNum 1, today's admitDate and SNF-######. Blank means '', 0, null or missing, so day_num 0 is blank, not invented. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
